title: Breakfast at Home
text:
Maria eats breakfast at home every morning. She likes eggs, bread and fruit. She drinks a cup of coffee with milk. Her favorite fruit is an orange.

Today she makes a sandwich for lunch. She puts cheese and tomato on the bread. She also takes a bottle of water. Maria eats her lunch at work.

questions.text: What does Maria drink with her breakfast?
options: a cup of coffee with milk

questions.text: What does Maria put on her sandwich?
Where does Maria probably eat her lunch today?
Why does Maria take a bottle of water with her lunch?
options: She wants something to drink while she eats.
She wants to wash the dishes.
She is going to the beach.

vocabulary.definition: the first meal of the day, eaten in the morning
two slices of bread with food between them
a soft or hard food made from milk
a container with a narrow neck, used for liquids

paragraph_translations: María desayuna en casa todas las mañanas. Le gustan los huevos, el pan y la fruta. Bebe una taza de café con leche. Su fruta favorita es la naranja.
Hoy prepara un sándwich para el almuerzo. Pone queso y tomate en el pan. También lleva una botella de agua. María come su almuerzo en el trabajo.
